about:
The one bound's test vectors (te_core.formalism's `bound`, and `at` under reading A), which the console's rho.ts
runs. null is unmeasured (a term, the max, or ρ where no kind is measured); JSON has no infinity, so ∞ is "inf".

vectors.why: void: the products count diverges at this k: a counted product is fed by a cycle of the step's whole-making system that has no fixed point (the cycle's chains, r = c k/(K^2 b), make more operand entries whole than they read, and that compounds), or no set of the products has a proved bound, so the bound has no figure on the whole step. The term is the best figure on a set of the products no such cycle feeds, a valid lower bound since that set keeps only products whose feeding classes converge; with no such set it has no figure, and the row's slowdown is floored at 1 with this reason

products.rests_on: theorem of record for this circuit: every partition into blocks of at most c gates, each reading at most k bits outside θ, does N ≤ m(k + α) + F·(k/2)·√(mO)/β of M's N MACs in its m blocks, α = F·½·√(k³/(β²·b_y)), so ρ ≥ (c/|C|)·(N/(k + α) − F·(k/2)·√(ON)/β/(k + α)^1.5), floored at 1, O M's output wires; given these premises on M, each refuted by a single counterexample: (H) operands are hard: every set of M's words with a cut of at most k bits from the unregistered inputs has a cut of at least β bits a word, β the least width M charges an operand: its width as the circuit passes it (a coded width where the capture records one), or β_eff = β/(1 + (K*/r)²), K* = ½√(k/β), for an operand the update reaches only through a bottleneck of rank r a row or column (an adapter's Ax, a broadcast vector, a frozen edge), with a product whose operand is below the β M takes left out of M; (E) exports are wide: every gate set's cut to the outputs it alone feeds is at least b_y bits an output, b_y M's least output width; and the structure, which the product rows don't record: M's matmuls have distinct words, W and X disjoint, no two share both a w- and an x-word, and no four arrays are pairwise multiplied (a layer's forward, input-gradient and weight-gradient products share three: F = 2/√3 where M holds a backward or optimizer product, else 1). M is the grader's: the products whose two operands both depend on the update, less one array times itself, a product reading a gather's rows, the positions sequences share, and the steps before the run's first update, which read registered weights
products.rule: for each t among the groups' least β (above 0): M_t the groups whose every β ≥ t, N and O their MACs and output wires, b_y their least output width, F = 2/sqrt(3) where a group isn't a forward product, else 1, alpha = F/2 sqrt(k^3/(t^2 b_y)); term = max(0, max over t of (c/C_gates) (N/(k + alpha) - F (k/2) sqrt(O N)/t/(k + alpha)^1.5)), and its beta, b_y, F, alpha, N and O are the best t's; rho floors it at 1

published_rule: Fit holds: rho_fit, binding fit. Else, where a kind's term exceeds 1: the max, binding that kind, partial where a kind is unmeasured. Else, where a kind is unmeasured: null, binding unmeasured, why naming it. Else: 1, binding none. products_rests_on is the products term's own, with its beta and b_y, wherever it is measured.

rests_on.token: assumption (A1, reading A) with its witness family, closed under unions: the runs of one traced token's path in segments (the trace's entries) and the matrix-product tiles of the record's op log, weight-gradient tiles among them; a block's work is a union of them, each part reading at most its k bits, so it holds at most the best run block plus every product's tile at k plus every gate no tile places; a block reading the update code at c gates

rule: rho = rho_fit where Fit holds, else max(1, the max over the kinds' terms); 1 where every kind is computed and none has a figure; null where a kind isn't computed and none has a figure. Sensitivities are never in the max.

sensitivities.decoding_form: sensitivity, assumption (D) with A1 (reading B): a block reading the update code runs the whole decoder, so it holds at most max(c - d, min(c, α (x0 s + s*))) affected gates, α the most affected gates a token has in any part, x0 and s* from the uncapped profiles; reading B isn't A1's approved reading
sensitivities.fresh_no_cell: rests on P-width extended, false on honest circuits: sensitivity, the old fresh-products figure without assuming that blocks hold whole multiply cells (P-cell), where a block may split a multiply cell
sensitivities.fresh_old: rests on P-width extended, false on honest circuits: sensitivity, the old fresh-products figure, the Loomis-Whitney cap on the products of two operands both paid at their passed width, amortized over the partition with each subset's whole-making chains, on the best subset, given every value a block reads costs its full width (P-width), extended to every value a block reads while making operands whole, elementwise steps don't fan out (P-match), each output is summed along one chain (P-chain), P-share and the standard algorithm, given that blocks hold whole multiply cells (P-cell)
sensitivities.per_gate: sensitivity, assumption (A1, reading A) with its witness family, not closed under unions: each gate at the best witness that holds it; a block holding one gate of a product beside another product's tile or the best run holds more, for a few bits of that gate's own operands
sensitivities.reduction: sensitivity, assumption (R): each block holding a step's token work passes one partial gradient at its passed width (the trace's partial cut), and the step's token work fills at least ceil(N w / c) blocks; it holds only for partitions split by tokens (a block holding only frozen layers passes no partial)
sensitivities.token_form: sensitivity, assumption (A1, reading B): Slowdown's token form, s* the largest x(k - u(x))/a over x and x0 from the input profile, u capped at Delta for a block reading the update code; reading B isn't A1's approved reading
sensitivities.update: sensitivity, assumption (U): where two or more blocks hold a step's token work, the block applying the update to a coordinate reads its share of the gradient's cut, the weights read once and theta free; it holds only for partitions split by tokens (a tensor's gradient made and applied in one block breaks it)

sessions.about: te_core.policy.session: one session of the reference model, each of its tokens a forward, every product of two operands at the served precision's GEMM price; the elementwise ops left out

dial.about: each k of the console's grid (te_core.policy's K_GRID): a session of in_tokens = k/16 input tokens and out_tokens output tokens, c its gates (te_core.policy.session_gates), the products term's c at k, and k_bits its input ids at the model's own vocabulary (k at 50,304, 15/16 of it at 32,000)

sessions.rule: c = (tokens·n_layer·(4·d_model² + 3·d_model·d_ff) + tokens·d_model·vocab + 2·n_layer·d_model·attended) x gates_per_mac, tokens = in + out, attended = in² + out·in + out·(out + 1)/2 (a prompt token over the whole prompt, the j-th output token over the prompt and the output tokens up to itself); k = in x ceil(log2 vocab)
